pool.description:
Lead GenAI Engineer AWS

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-time

Experience: 5 to 9 years

Cloud Requirement: AWS Mandatory (Amazon Bedrock & SageMaker)

About the Role We need a technical leader to own the architecture and deployment of our Generative AI systems entirely on AWS. This is a hands-on leadership role-you will be making the big architectural calls, mentoring a talented team, and personally building the most complex parts of our GenAI platform. Because our infrastructure is heavily cloud-native, deep and proven, experience with Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker is a hard requirement. If you enjoy owning a GenAI strategy end-to-end and scaling systems securely in the cloud, we want to talk to you.

What You'll Do

  • Architect and lead the development of end-to-end GenAI systems, covering everything from data ingestion to deployment and observability.
  • Build and scale solutions using Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker JumpStart, while integrating complementary services like OpenSearch Serverless.
  • Drive technical direction for complex RAG architectures (GraphRAG, agentic RAG) and multi-agent orchestration.
  • Lead and mentor a team of AI engineers and data scientists, growing their technical depth through design and code reviews.
  • Own the "FinOps" of our GenAI workloads-managing token economics, caching strategies, and provisioned throughput to keep costs in check.
  • Ensure enterprise-grade security and compliance by strictly applying AWS best practices (IAM least-privilege, KMS encryption, VPC isolation).

What Were Looking For

  • 5-9 years in software engineering, ML, or data science, including 1-2+ years operating in a lead or architectural role.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience actively shipping Generative AI products into production.
  • AWS Mastery: Extensive, hands-on experience provisioning and scaling models via Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker, alongside strong Infrastructure-as-Code skills (Terraform, CDK).
  • High-level proficiency in Python, the AWS SDK (boto3), and building asynchronous APIs (like FastAPI).
  • Expertise in agentic workflows (LangGraph, CrewAI) and prompt engineering at scale.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical trade-offs to executives and business stakeholders.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Active AWS Certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty, or Solutions Architect).
  • Experience fine-tuning models or managing custom model deployments on Bedrock.
  • A background working in regulated industries (healthcare, finance) where navigating strict data privacy compliance is crucial.

Role: Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Location: Vashi, Navi Mumbai (4 days in a week from office)

Work timings: Office work from 12:00pm to 5:00pm and then remote 7:30pm to 10:00pm


Job Overview

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI & ML Data Collection, you will play a critical role in building and scaling the companys Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform, enabling standardized, reliable, and scalable machine learning capabilities across the organization. This role will focus on transforming existing AI/ML and LLM-driven data systems into a cohesive platform that supports data pipelines, model lifecycle management, evaluation frameworks, and production deployment.

This position requires deep hands-on expertise in machine learning engineering, LLM-based systems, ML platform development, and MLOps. You will work closely with ML engineers, product managers, researchers, and business stakeholders to deliver production-ready AI/ML systems aligned with broader business objectives and AI/ML strategy.

You will be deeply involved in the design, development, and operationalization of platform components, including data ingestion, feature management, model training and evaluation, scalable inference systems, and model observability capabilities.

You will help ensure that AI/ML systems are production-ready, observable, maintainable, and cost-efficient, with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, governance, and developer productivity. You will leverage your expertise in areas such as large language models (LLM), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and ML Operations (MLOps).

You will contribute to the end-to-end lifecycle of ML systems, from experimentation and prototyping to deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement while mentoring engineers and promoting strong engineering practices across the team.

Team Overview

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team of ML engineers responsible for building and maintaining the Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform. The team focuses on developing scalable systems that support data pipelines, model lifecycle management, LLM-based workflows, and evaluation frameworks, enabling downstream teams to build and deploy AI-driven data collection solutions.

Outline of Duties and Responsibilities

  • AI-Powered Data Collection Systems: Design and develop scalable AI-driven data collection and enrichment workflows across structured and unstructured data sources.
  • LLM & Generative AI Workflows: Build LLM-based capabilities including RAG systems, prompt orchestration, entity extraction, summarization, classification, and automated validation workflows.
  • Agentic Frameworks & Model Context Integration: Design and implement agentic workflows and model-to-tool integrations that connect AI models with internal tools, APIs, knowledge stores, data sources, and workflow systems.
  • Model Deployment & Lifecycle Management: Deploy, maintain, and optimize ML and LLM models in production, including model versioning, CI/CD, experiment tracking, model registry, rollout strategies, and rollback mechanisms.
  • Data Quality & Evaluation: Build frameworks for evaluating extraction quality, model performance, hallucination risks, grounding, consistency, latency, coverage, and overall data reliability.
  • Observability & Operational Excellence: Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, cost tracking, model performance monitoring, drift detection, and reliability dashboards for production AI/ML systems.
  • Scalable Platform Engineering: Design distributed, event-driven, and cloud-native systems using asynchronous processing, message queues, containerization, and orchestration patterns to support high-volume workloads.
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies, LLM frameworks, orchestration tools, vector databases, and model deployment approaches to improve automation capabilities and developer productivity.
  • Company Values: Model company values and contribute to a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering or data science, with a focus on machine learning systems, ML platforms, or distributed systems.
  • Strong experience building production-grade ML systems, including model deployment and lifecycle management.
  • Hands-on experience with MLOps tools and practices, including CI/CD, model monitoring, and experiment tracking.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, or similar languages.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and containerization (e.g., AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with LLM-based systems in production, including RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector databases.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and system design trade-offs.
  • Proven ability to solve complex technical challenges and deliver scalable solutions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across global teams.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, data-driven environments.

Working Conditions

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phones on an ongoing basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer

pool.description:
Full Stack Developer (.NET Core / Angular / API Integration) - OTA

Company: Kavya Travel Company
Company Headquarters: USA
Location: India (Onsite)
Office Address: Stellar Serve Business Solutions, Building: Stellar 1423, 10th Floor, Noida, UP - 201305
Compensation: 6 LPA - 12 LPA (based on experience and technical capability)
Shift Timing: 6:00 PM - 3:00 AM IST (Focusing on U.S. business hours)


About the Role

Kavya Travel Company is an Online Travel Agency (OTA) building a technology-driven travel booking platform for customers in international markets. Kavya Travel Company, in partnership with Stellar Serve Business Solutions, is looking for a hands-on Full Stack Developer who can help build, integrate, improve, and support the platform across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, CRM, payments, and production systems.

This is a product-development role, not a narrow frontend or backend position. The developer will work on the actual customer booking journey as well as the internal systems used by sales, reservations, customer service, and operations teams. The platform will connect multiple travel suppliers and business systems, so strong API integration and troubleshooting ability is important.

We are primarily looking for a mid-experience developer with approximately 2-6 years of real full stack development experience. The person should be capable of owning meaningful features, understanding how different parts of the application connect, and helping us build a stable and scalable OTA platform.


Key Responsibilities

Full Stack OTA Product Development

  • Develop complete product features across database, backend services, APIs, and Angular frontend screens
  • Build and improve customer-facing travel search, selection, booking, checkout, payment, confirmation, and post-booking workflows
  • Develop internal tools used by sales, reservations, customer service, operations, and management teams
  • Convert business requirements and UI designs into stable production features
  • Maintain existing functionality while adding new modules as the OTA platform expands
  • Troubleshoot issues that may involve frontend code, backend services, databases, supplier APIs, payment systems, or CRM workflows

Backend Development - C# / .NET Core / ASP.NET Core

  • Develop REST APIs and backend services using C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core
  • Build business logic for travel search, pricing, booking, customer, payment, confirmation, and post-booking functions
  • Use organized MVC / service-layer architecture and Entity Framework Core where appropriate
  • Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access, and secure API access including JWT-based authentication
  • Build proper validation, error handling, logging, and audit trails so production booking and payment issues can be traced
  • Optimize backend services and investigate performance or reliability problems

Frontend Development - Angular / TypeScript

  • Develop Angular applications using TypeScript, reusable components, services, forms, routing, and responsive layouts
  • Build flight or travel search screens, filters, product selection, traveler-detail forms, checkout, and confirmation pages
  • Consume backend APIs and correctly handle loading states, validation, errors, and changing API responses
  • Work with the designer to convert approved UI concepts into functional customer-facing screens
  • Build CRM and internal operational screens for employees managing customers, bookings, payments, and service requests
  • Troubleshoot frontend production issues and improve performance across desktop and mobile devices

Travel APIs, GDS & Third-Party Integrations

  • Integrate flight, airline, GDS, consolidator, aggregator, or other travel supplier APIs
  • Work with REST APIs and, where required, SOAP/XML services and large JSON/XML responses
  • Normalize supplier data into a consistent internal structure that can be used by the website and CRM
  • Handle availability, schedules, fares, fare rules, pricing changes, booking responses, confirmation data, and supplier errors
  • Build safeguards for API timeouts, failed responses, duplicate requests, missing data, and other integration problems
  • Maintain supplier request/response logs so live booking issues can be investigated efficiently

OTA Booking Flow & Transaction Logic

  • Develop the end-to-end journey from search and availability through traveler details, payment, booking creation, and confirmation
  • Ensure booking and payment status remains accurate when a transaction passes through multiple internal and external systems
  • Support customer account, booking history, confirmation, change, cancellation, refund, or service-request workflows where applicable
  • Prevent duplicate booking or duplicate payment actions caused by repeated requests, retries, or failed responses
  • Design workflows that clearly distinguish successful, failed, pending, incomplete, and cancelled transactions

Database Development - SQL Server & MongoDB

  • Design and maintain SQL Server tables and relationships for customers, bookings, payments, application settings, and operational records
  • Write and optimize queries, stored procedures, indexes, and database objects as required
  • Use Entity Framework Core for application data access where appropriate
  • Use MongoDB for API responses, logs, search data, or other document-oriented data where useful
  • Protect data integrity when multiple systems update the same booking or transaction and investigate database-related performance issues

CRM & Internal Operations Systems

  • Develop or integrate CRM functionality used by sales, customer service, reservations, and operations teams
  • Create customer profiles and consolidated booking views showing booking status, payment status, supplier details, notes, and activity history
  • Build employee workflows for service requests, booking changes, cancellations, refunds, follow-up activity, and internal notes
  • Implement user roles and access controls so employees see only the functions relevant to their responsibilities
  • Connect website leads, customer data, booking records, payment information, and operational workflows with internal systems

Payment Gateway Integration

  • Integrate payment gateway APIs into customer checkout and internal payment workflows
  • Handle authorization, success, decline, error, pending, callback, and webhook responses correctly
  • Ensure every payment result is linked to the correct customer and booking record
  • Maintain sufficient transaction logs for investigating payment and booking discrepancies
  • Follow secure development practices and avoid unnecessary storage or exposure of sensitive payment information

Production Deployment & Technical Support

  • Deploy and maintain application changes across development, testing, and production environments
  • Investigate live issues using application logs, supplier responses, database records, and frontend/backend behavior
  • Fix defects without unnecessarily disrupting existing booking, customer, or payment workflows
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, release planning, technical documentation, and production support
  • Work with Azure or comparable cloud environments and contribute to CI/CD, caching, monitoring, or deployment improvements as the platform grows

Required Technical Skills

  • C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, and REST API development
  • Angular and TypeScript with practical frontend development experience
  • SQL Server and Entity Framework Core
  • MongoDB or comparable document-database experience
  • Third-party API integration and debugging of complex API responses
  • Authentication and authorization, including JWT or comparable secure access methods
  • HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive web development, and Git/source-control workflows
  • Strong debugging ability across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases

Required Skills & Experience

  • Approximately 2-6 years of real full stack application development experience
  • Hands-on experience building production web applications using .NET and Angular or a closely comparable full stack environment
  • Experience creating and consuming REST APIs and integrating external third-party systems
  • Experience working with relational databases such as SQL Server and handling production data safely
  • Experience working across both frontend and backend layers within the same product or project
  • Experience deploying, debugging, and maintaining applications after release
  • Strong problem-solving ability and the confidence to investigate issues independently
  • Good written and spoken English communication and ability to work onsite in Noida during the required shift

Good to Have

  • Previous OTA, travel portal, airline booking, hotel booking, e-commerce, fintech, or other transaction-heavy platform experience
  • Experience integrating Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport, airline NDC, consolidator, or similar travel APIs
  • Understanding of travel booking concepts such as PNRs, fare rules, ticketing, cancellations, and refunds
  • Azure cloud deployment experience, Redis/caching, CI/CD pipelines, or release automation
  • Experience integrating payment gateways and handling transaction reconciliation or callback/webhook flows
  • Experience building CRM, internal operations, or employee workflow systems

Ideal Candidate

  • Has 2-6 years of hands-on full stack development experience and is genuinely comfortable with both .NET backend and Angular frontend development
  • Has built API-heavy production applications and can integrate and troubleshoot complex third-party systems
  • Understands that an OTA is a transaction workflow connecting search, booking, payment, supplier, customer, and internal operational systems - not simply a content website
  • Can help develop both customer-facing booking features and CRM / internal operational functionality
  • Can investigate production problems across multiple application layers and take increasing ownership as the OTA platform grows

We are looking for a Marketing Technology Engineer to own the technology, tracking, and data infrastructure that powers our digital marketing efforts. This role bridges Marketing, Product, and Engineering by ensuring customer interactions are accurately captured, marketing platforms are seamlessly integrated, and data flows reliably across our technology ecosystem.

You will be responsible for implementing and maintaining website tracking, marketing automation integrations, customer data collection, attribution, and analytics infrastructure. Your work will enable better decision-making, improve campaign performance, and provide the foundation for personalization and AI-driven marketing initiatives.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, optimizing marketing systems, and building reliable data pipelines that connect customer behavior with business outcomes.

Marketing Tracking & Analytics

  • Own the implementation and maintenance of Google Analytics 4 (GA4) across multiple websites.

Data & Integrations

  • Validate data flowing between websites, analytics platforms, and business systems.
  • Build automated reporting datasets using SQL and BigQuery.
  • Ensure data quality across marketing and customer platforms.
  • Troubleshoot discrepancies between marketing platforms and internal reporting.

Attribution & Performance

  • Maintain attribution models and campaign tracking standards.
  • Analyze traffic sources, customer journeys, and conversion funnels.
  • Support A/B testing initiatives through accurate experiment tracking.
  • Provide insights into campaign performance and marketing ROI.
  • Work with marketing teams to improve conversion measurement.

AI & Personalization

  • Build the data foundation required for personalization initiatives.
  • Support predictive marketing and customer segmentation projects.
  • Ensure behavioral data is available for machine learning models.
  • Partner with AI and engineering teams on personalization strategies.

Technologies You Will Work With:

  • Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

pool.description:
Senior .NET Developer


Location: Hyderabad, India
Company: Intelex Systems Private Limited
Product: Fleetly Fleet Safety, Video Telematics & IoT Platform
Employment Type: Full-time


Position Overview


Intelex Systems is looking for a highly skilled Senior .NET Developer to join our engineering team in Hyderabad and contribute to the continued development of Fleetly, our advanced fleet management, video telematics and connected vehicle platform.


This role is ideal for someone with strong expertise in C#/.NET, TCP/IP server development, multi-threaded systems, real-time data processing and Azure cloud services. You will work on high-performance backend services that communicate with vehicle tracking devices, cameras, IoT hardware and cloud infrastructure.


As a senior member of the Fleetly engineering team, you will help design and build critical platform components including real-time telemetry ingestion, device communication protocols, video telematics services, alert processing, cloud integrations and scalable backend APIs.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop and maintain high-performance backend services using C# and .NET.
  • Build and optimise TCP/IP server communication modules for real-time data exchange with IoT devices, telematics units and edge hardware.
  • Develop reliable multi-threaded and asynchronous applications capable of handling high-volume concurrent device connections.
  • Integrate backend services with Azure IoT Hub, Event Hubs, Service Bus, Functions, Blob Storage, Cosmos DB and Azure SQL.
  • Design and implement APIs for device data ingestion, processing, reporting and platform communication.
  • Work on real-time vehicle tracking, event processing, video telematics workflows and connected device management.
  • Analyse device protocols, decode payloads and implement proprietary or industry-standard communication stacks.
  • Collaborate with hardware teams, cloud architects, QA engineers, frontend developers and product stakeholders.
  • Improve system performance, scalability, reliability and observability across platform services.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews and code reviews.
  • Mentor junior developers and promote strong engineering practices within the team.
  • Implement appropriate logging, diagnostics, monitoring, exception handling and automated testing.
  • Support release readiness, defect resolution and production issue analysis when required.

Essential Skills and Experience:


  • 4+ years of professional backend development experience using C# and .NET Core / .NET Framework.
  • Strong experience in TCP/IP socket programming, TCP servers and device communication services.
  • Excellent understanding of multi-threading, concurrency, asynchronous programming and background processing.
  • Experience building high-throughput, low-latency and resilient server-side applications.
  • Practical experience with Azure services such as:
    • Azure IoT Hub
    • Event Hubs
    • Azure Functions
    • Service Bus
    • Blob Storage
    • Cosmos DB
    • Azure SQL
    • Application Insights

  • Good understanding of microservices, distributed systems and cloud-based application architecture.
  • Experience with device or machine integration protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, FTP/SFTP, TCP binary protocols or proprietary data protocols.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, background workers, message queues and data processing pipelines.
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, secure and well-documented code.
  • Experience with unit testing, integration testing and debugging complex production issues.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, source control and modern development workflows.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills in English.

Desirable Skills


Experience in any of the following areas would be a strong advantage:


  • Fleet management, telematics, vehicle tracking or automotive IoT platforms.
  • Video telematics, dashcam integrations, MDVRs or connected camera systems.
  • Azure Cosmos DB performance tuning, partitioning and RU optimisation.
  • Real-time messaging using WebSockets, SignalR, gRPC or MQTT.
  • Data compression, binary protocol decoding or high-volume telemetry processing.
  • Docker, Kubernetes or containerised service deployments.
  • Monitoring and observability tools such as Azure Application Insights, Grafana or Azure Monitor.
  • Security best practices for cloud services, APIs and connected devices.
  • AI/ADAS/DMS or driver safety technology experience.

What You Will Work On

As part of the Fleetly platform team, you may work on:


  • Real-time vehicle tracking and telemetry ingestion.
  • TCP device communication servers.
  • Event and alert processing pipelines.
  • Video telematics workflows and media services.
  • Device health monitoring and diagnostics.
  • Driver behaviour and safety event processing.
  • Azure-based IoT and cloud integrations.
  • Scalable backend services for UK and international fleet customers.

Why Join Intelex Systems?

  • Work on Fleetly, a real-world fleet safety and video telematics platform used by commercial fleets.
  • Be part of a growing technology company developing products for the UK, European and international markets.
  • Work on challenging engineering problems involving real-time data, IoT devices, cloud scale and connected vehicles.
  • Opportunity to contribute to AI-enabled fleet safety, driver behaviour analysis and next-generation transport technology.
  • Collaborative engineering culture with focus on quality, ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Opportunity to mentor others and grow into Technical Architect, Engineering Lead or Platform Lead roles.
  • Eligible for career growth opportunities and potential equity/share option participation based on performance and business criteria.

Ideal Candidate


The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex backend and real-time system challenges. You should be comfortable working with device data, cloud services, performance-sensitive systems and production-grade software. You will be expected to take ownership of technical delivery, contribute to architecture decisions and help build a reliable, scalable and secure platform.


How to Apply

Please submit your CV along with details of your relevant experience in .NET backend development, TCP/IP communication, Azure cloud services and any IoT or telematics projects you have worked on to our HR team via Naukri.

pool.title: Business Development Manager - Automotive & Embedded Engineering
pool.description:
CAREER OPPORTUNITY


Business Development Manager (Future Sales Leader)

Automotive & Embedded Engineering | Pune, Hinjawadi


THE MANDATE Build Devanture's next phase of growth by originating and converting engineering opportunities across India, Singapore and selected international markets.


About Devanture

Devanture is a Singapore-headquartered automotive and embedded engineering company with a newly setup engineering delivery base in Pune. Our work spans TCU and connected-vehicle engineering, automotive embedded software and selected embedded-systems engagements. We are building a specialist engineering business that combines deep technical authority with disciplined commercial execution.


The opportunity


We are seeking a hands-on and highly self-driven business development professional who already operates within the automotive, embedded-systems or engineering-services market. This is not a generic lead-generation role. The successful candidate will represent Devanture independently, open credible doors, identify customer problems that can become engineering engagements, qualify opportunities and drive them through proposal, negotiation and closure.


As Devantures first dedicated business-development hire, you will have the opportunity to help shape our sales strategy, market approach and future business-development organisation. We are looking for someone with the ambition and capability to grow into a sales leadership role as the business expands.


This is a high-ownership position in a growing organisation. Success will be measured by the candidates ability to build a qualified pipeline and generate meaningful new revenue during the first year. The role is best suited to someone who is proactive, commercially accountable and comfortable building opportunities without waiting for a large established sales infrastructure.

India will be the initial priority market. Singapore is Devantures commercial and international hub, and the role will also develop selected opportunities in Singapore, Southeast Asia and other relevant international markets.


You must be comfortable operating independently, creating your own account strategy and being accountable for measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes. This position is intended for candidates who genuinely want to build a market and grow into a future sales leadership rolenot those seeking a primarily account-management or lead-coordination position.



Key responsibilities


  • Develop new business for TCU, connected-vehicle, automotive embedded-software and credible non-automotive embedded-engineering and mobility HW /SW services.
  • Build and execute account plans for OEMs, Tier-1 and Tier-2 suppliers, mobility and electronics companies, product companies and engineering-services buyers.
  • Use existing market relationships and disciplined outbound activity to secure relevant customer introductions and meetings.
  • Identify engineering problems, buying triggers, budgets, decision-makers, timelines and competitive context; distinguish real opportunities from speculative enquiries.
  • Lead initial discovery and commercial qualification, then engage Devanture technical authority and engineering team when deeper solution design is justified.
  • Coordinate technical proposals, scope development, estimates, presentations, commercial submissions and follow-ups.
  • Drive opportunities through negotiation, contracting, project start and collection of initial revenue.
  • Develop India-based opportunities while using Devanture Singapore presence to access regional headquarters, international customers and Southeast Asian markets.
  • Represent Devanture at customer meetings, relevant industry events and partner discussions; travel as required for qualified opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, account intelligence, opportunity stages, next actions, forecasts and win/loss learning.
  • Share structured market feedback to sharpen Devanture offerings, positioning, case studies and sales assets.
  • Build partner and referral channels where they create qualified access to customer engineering programmes.

What success looks like

  • A credible, qualified pipeline across automotive and embedded-engineering accounts.
  • At least one meaningful new paying engineering customer during the first year.
  • 1 crore in eligible new collected service revenue as the first-year target, with 1.5 crore as the stretch target.
  • A year-end qualified pipeline of approximately 35 crore, supported by named buyers, defined needs, realistic timing and agreed next steps.
  • Increasing ability to represent Devanture independently in early-stage customer conversations, while using technical specialists efficiently.

Candidate Profile

Essential

  • Approximately 6 - 10 years of relevant business-development, sales or account-development experience in automotive engineering, embedded systems, electronics product engineering or engineering services.
  • Demonstrable access to relevant customer organisations and the ability to explain how those relationships could translate into opportunities not merely a list of well-known company names.
  • Evidence of personally originating or materially developing engineering-services or technology engagements through to commercial closure.
  • Working understanding of embedded-software and product-engineering terminology sufficient to conduct initial discovery and qualification.
  • Strong customer communication, consultative selling, commercial judgement, follow-through and pipeline discipline.
  • Ability to work from Pune/Hinjawadi and travel for customer meetings.

Strongly preferred

  • Experience with automotive OEMs, Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers, TCU/telematics, connected vehicles, diagnostics, OTA/FOTA, vehicle connectivity or related engineering domains.
  • Experience selling from an India engineering base to international customers or regional headquarters.
  • Relevant relationships or market exposure in Singapore or Southeast Asia.
  • Experience working with technical presales, engineering leaders and delivery teams to shape proposals.
  • An engineering or technology-related qualification. Commercial credibility and results matter more than the degree title.

Reporting and collaboration

The role reports directly to the CEO and commercial leader. The successful candidate will work closely with Devantures TCU technical authority and engineering team for qualified discovery, solution shaping and technical proposals. The business development manager owns market development and opportunity progression; final technical commitments and commercial approvals remain with the authorised Devanture leaders.


Compensation

Fixed compensation: 14 -18 lakh per annum, depending on relevant experience, demonstrated market access and track record. A performance-linked commission on eligible collected service revenue will apply. Approved customer travel and event participation will be handled separately in accordance with company policy and business justification.


How to apply

Please submit your rsum to together with a short note covering: (1) the customer segments and engineering services you have sold; (2) two relevant wins and your personal contribution; and (3) how you would approach Devantures first 90 days in India and selected international markets.


Location: Pune, Hinjawadi | Regular customer travel | India priority with Singapore and selected international market development

Job Description
About the role and team
Leading at Uber means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. As a COE Team Lead II, you are a leader of leaders, responsible for navigating the complex intersection of global policy and local operational reality. You wont just manage tasks; youll build high-performing teams in an ambiguous, rotational shift environment, making hard calls under pressure and carrying the weight of decisions that impact both our people and our community.

Youll be tasked with turning data and audit insights into actionable growth, all while maintaining the high talent bar that excellence requires. If you are a resilient, strategic thinker who can lead with clarity and heart through constant change, this is where youll make your mark.

  • Proficiency in Google suite

  • Flexibility to support a rotational shift operation, including potential nights, weekends, and holidays
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in cross-functional stakeholder leadership

  • Exceptional systems thinking skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable leadership strategies
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and build trust across disparate teams and regions
  • A "go-get-it" attitude with a track record of taking ownership of results during periods of high ambiguity

This role is part of the companys establishment of their new India Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Bengaluru which will drive enterprise technology, digital transformation and innovation for its global operations and contributing to technology that ultimately helps millions of people around the world.

The position works closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, and business stakeholders in a highly regulated environment. It is suited for professionals with strong privacy, audit, and risk management experience who can contribute to secure and compliant technology delivery.


Role & responsibilities


• Own and communicate the product vision and roadmap for Azure platforms and services, aligned with business and technology strategies.

  • Translate business needs into well-defined epics, features, and user stories, maintaining a prioritized and transparent product backlog.

• Own AI use case identification and intake on Azure, partnering with business and technology leaders to build and prioritize a portfolio of AI-enabled capabilities aligned to measurable business outcomes.

  • Define and evolve the AI product strategy and roadmap for Azure, including generative AI, AI agents, and LLM-based solutions built on Azure OpenAI Service and Azure AI Studio.
  • Drive AI business value realization through clear success metrics, adoption tracking, and ROI reporting for each AI product on the roadmap.
  • Partner with security, legal, and risk teams to embed AI governance, responsible AI, and compliance requirements (data privacy, model risk, human-in-the-loop controls) into the backlog and acceptance criteria. • Track and report AI adoption metrics (active users, use case maturity, productivity impact, cost per inference) and use these insights to reprioritize the backlog.

• Prioritize AI-enabled capabilities against traditional platform work, balancing foundational cloud investments with high-value AI opportunities.

  • Partner with architecture, security, and operations teams to ensure Azure solutions meet standards for reliability, scalability, security, and compliance.

• Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring clarity of acceptance criteria and value delivery.

  • Act as the primary business liaison, balancing stakeholder expectations, dependencies, and trade-offs to maximize outcomes.
  • Monitor product performance using KPIs and metrics, driving continuous improvement and value realization.
  • Support cloud adoption and modernization initiatives, including migration, optimization, and platform enhancements.

Preferred candidate profile


• Qualifications

• Education:

• Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field required.

• Master’s degree (e.g., MS, MBA) preferred.

• Experience and Skills: • Required:

• 4+ years of experience in IT product ownership, cloud platform management, product management, or business systems analysis.

• Strong technical knowledge of Microsoft Azure services (e.g., compute, storage, networking, identity, DevOps) and cloud delivery models.

• Hands-on familiarity with Azure AI and platform tooling, including: Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Studio, Azure AI Search, Azure Container Apps, Azure Deployment Environments, AI Agents frameworks, GitHub Copilot, and ServiceNow (for AI product intake and adoption tracking). • Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions, including writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, collaborating daily with development and platform teams.

• Proven business acumen to prioritize work based on value, risk, and dependencies while managing multiple stakeholders.

• Strong communication and leadership skills, influencing without authority and facilitating alignment across technical and non-technical teams.

• Preferred:

• Experience supporting enterprise-scale cloud platforms in regulated or global environments.

• Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code.

• Prior experience working with global stakeholders across regions and time zones.

• Ability to mentor team members and contribute to product management best practices.


• Other:

• Language: Proficiency in English required.

• Travel: Up to 10–15% international travel, as needed. • Certifications: Azure or Agile-related certifications (e.g., Azure Fundamentals, Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Administrator, SAFe, Scrum Product Owner). Azure AI or Generative AI credentials strongly preferred.

pool.description:
We are seeking a Lead Java Engineer AI Native to design, build and own complex production systems while championing AI-native engineering practices across a team. In this role, you will combine deep Java expertise with hands-on AI agent and MCP development to deliver scalable, intelligent solutions end-to-end.

Responsibilities
  • Design, develop and maintain scalable Java applications using Spring Boot and microservices architecture, owning features end-to-end with a high degree of autonomy
  • Build and deploy Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that expose Java services, databases or internal tools to LLM-based agents enabling agents to act on live enterprise data and systems
  • Implement end-to-end agentic SDLC pipelines: automated specification drafting, AI-driven code generation, intelligent test creation, CI/CD integration and deployment validation orchestrated by AI agents
  • Integrate agentic pipelines with enterprise tools and platforms (Jira, Confluence, GitHub, ServiceNow, observability stacks) via MCP connectors or REST/event-driven APIs
  • Use AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code or equivalent) and frontier LLMs (Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini) across the full development lifecycle every day, critically evaluating AI outputs for correctness, security and edge cases before committing
  • Bring an AI-first mindset to automate repetitive engineering tasks, measure outcomes rather than activity and identify AI-leverage opportunities within your delivery area
  • Contribute to the team's shared library of prompt templates, reusable agent patterns and MCP connectors
  • Conduct code and architecture reviews, mentor Junior and Mid-level engineers in Java best practices and AI-native engineering methods
  • Maintain strong automated test coverage (unit, integration, contract, AI-generated) and healthy CI/CD pipeline practices
  • Track frontier developments new model releases (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama), emerging agent frameworks, new MCP connectors and bring relevant changes back to the team within weeks
Requirements
  • 812 years of professional Java development with clear ownership of complex production systems
  • Deep expertise in Spring Boot, Spring Cloud and Spring Data, plus Spring Security and microservices design patterns
  • Strong architectural skills across distributed systems, event-driven architecture and domain-driven design (DDD), including CQRS/ES
  • Cloud-native engineering on AWS, GCP or Azure IaC, serverless patterns, managed services and cloud-native observability
  • Proven experience leading technical teams through architecture governance, coding standards and mentoring and technical onboarding
  • Active daily use of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code or equivalent) and frontier LLMs (Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini), fluent across the full SDLC and able to coach a team of 815 engineers in AI-native practices
  • Proven hands-on experience designing, building and deploying MCP server ecosystems at project or account scale including security controls, versioning and observability
  • Demonstrated ability to architect and operate end-to-end agentic SDLC pipelines that integrate with real enterprise tools via MCP and APIs, built and run in production rather than only in a proof of concept
  • Experience evaluating and selecting AI agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Spring AI Agents or equivalent) for production use with documented rationale and trade-offs
  • Track record of improving a team's AI maturity with measurable change supported by adoption metrics or productivity evidence
  • Demonstrated learning agility at team scale, showing that your team's engineering practices changed meaningfully in the last 12 months because of evolving frontier models and tools and that you drove that change
  • English proficiency: Upper-Intermediate or above (B2+)
Nice to have
  • Experience with RAG pipelines, LLM fine-tuning or LLM evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, DeepEval or similar) applied to software engineering contexts
  • Hands-on experience with structured agentic SDLC methodologies specification-driven AI development, specification hardening or equivalent governed delivery protocols
  • Experience with Managed Services or AIOps delivery models: autonomous monitoring, AI-assisted incident response or intelligent operations pipelines
  • Capability to design function calling and tool-use across multiple frontier models, building reliable governed tool-use chains
  • Contributions to internal AI maturity assessments, team certification programmes or AI engineering playbooks

pool.title: Senior SAP ABAP Consultant
pool.description:
Role Overview

The Senior SAP ABAP Consultant is a senior individual-contributor and technical leadership role responsible for designing, developing, optimizing, and supporting custom SAP solutions across implementation, upgrade, migration, and production-support engagements.

The position requires 810 years of hands-on SAP ABAP development experience, strong ownership of complex technical deliverables, and the ability to translate functional requirements into reliable, maintainable, and performance-efficient solutions.

The employer is an expanding enterprise SaaS product organization focused on AI-enabled digital assurance and collaborative, cross-functional engineering.

Reporting through a flat, matrixed structure to senior technical and delivery leadership, the consultant will lead technical discussions, guide junior developers, and work closely with functional consultants, Basis teams, business stakeholders, and client-facing teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and implement SAP ABAP programs covering reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, and forms as complete RICEF deliverables.
  • Translate approved business and functional requirements into clear technical specifications, solution designs, development estimates, and executable implementation plans.
  • Develop and maintain custom SAP applications using ABAP Objects, object-oriented design principles, ALV reporting, reusable classes, interfaces, and structured exception handling.
  • Build enhancements using BAPIs, BADIs, User Exits, Customer Exits, Enhancement Spots, and the SAP Enhancement Framework while protecting solution stability and upgrade compatibility.
  • Engineer integrations using IDocs, RFCs, SOAP or REST web services, OData services, and proxies supporting PI/PO-connected landscapes where applicable.
  • Create and maintain Smart Forms, SAPscript, and Adobe Forms, ensuring accurate output logic, layouts, data handling, and production reliability.
  • Review peer code for correctness, readability, security, reuse, transport readiness, and adherence to established ABAP coding and documentation standards.
  • Optimize existing and newly developed programs through disciplined debugging, SQL and runtime analysis, efficient internal-table processing, and performance-tuning practices.
  • Support SAP S/4HANA migration or implementation activities, including ABAP on HANA development using CDS Views and AMDP where the project scope requires them.
  • Diagnose production incidents, perform root-cause analysis, implement permanent fixes, and communicate resolution status clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Document technical specifications, program logic, interface mappings, unit-test plans, test evidence, deployment dependencies, and support handover information.
  • Mentor junior ABAP developers through design guidance, code reviews, debugging support, technical knowledge sharing, and reinforcement of delivery best practices.
  • Collaborate with functional, Basis, business, quality, and client-facing teams to deliver end-to-end SAP implementation, upgrade, enhancement, and support outcomes.

Required Qualifications

A completed Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field is mandatory.

The candidate must be able to substantiate the academic qualification through completed credentials and demonstrate an applied foundation in programming, systems analysis, software engineering, or enterprise application development.

No SAP certification is mandatory for eligibility; relevant SAP ABAP or SAP S/4HANA development certification will be treated as a value-added credential.


Required Experience

A total of 8–10 years of relevant, hands-on SAP ABAP development experience is required. Relevant experience must include direct ownership of development, enhancement, integration, debugging, performance, documentation, and production-support activities rather than observation-only or coordination-only exposure.

The candidate should have completed work across end-to-end SAP implementation, upgrade, migration, enhancement, and support assignments, with demonstrable delivery of RICEF objects and custom SAP solutions in production environments.

Experience collaborating with functional consultants and business stakeholders is essential. Prior consulting, client-facing, technical work-stream leadership, or small-team leadership experience is preferred.

Professional exposure within established SAP consulting, enterprise technology, IT product development, or large-scale client delivery environments is relevant to the role.


Technical and Functional Skills

  • Advanced SAP ABAP development capability, including procedural ABAP and ABAP Objects with sound object-oriented concepts.
  • Strong RICEF delivery experience covering reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, and forms.
  • Hands-on development using ALV reports, BAPIs, BADIs, User Exits, Customer Exits, Enhancement Spots, and the Enhancement Framework.
  • Integration development using IDocs, RFCs, SOAP or REST web services, OData services, and proxies; PI/PO integration exposure is beneficial.
  • Production experience with Smart Forms, SAPscript, and Adobe Forms development and maintenance.
  • Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, code optimization, and performance-tuning capability.
  • Ability to create technical specifications, unit-test plans, test evidence, transport notes, and maintainable technical documentation.
  • Working understanding of at least one SAP functional module: SD, MM, FICO, PP, or WM.
  • Practical knowledge of SAP Transport Management System and disciplined movement of changes across SAP landscapes.
  • Capability to perform code reviews, enforce coding standards, identify reusable patterns, and improve maintainability.
  • Understanding of Agile or Scrum delivery practices and cross-functional execution is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of version-control approaches, including Git for ABAP where adopted, is beneficial.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies

  • Demonstrates structured analytical thinking and resolves complex defects through evidence-based debugging and root-cause analysis.
  • Communicates technical concepts clearly to developers, functional consultants, business stakeholders, and client-facing teams.
  • Exercises ownership from requirement clarification through development, testing, deployment, stabilization, and documentation.
  • Mentors junior developers constructively and improves team quality through reviews, coaching, and knowledge sharing.
  • Balances multiple priorities while protecting delivery commitments, coding quality, and production stability.
  • Collaborates effectively in a flat, matrixed environment and remains responsive to cross-functional dependencies.
  • Shows sound judgment during production incidents and escalates risks, assumptions, and dependencies transparently.
  • Adapts to changing project needs while maintaining professional discipline, attention to detail, and customer focus.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications

  • Hands-on SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration experience, particularly ABAP on HANA development.
  • Development experience with CDS Views, AMDP, and ABAP Managed Database Procedures.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Fiori or UI5 backend development and OData service development.
  • Experience developing or supporting SAP Workflow solutions.
  • Exposure to SAP Business Technology Platform.
  • Relevant SAP certification in ABAP or SAP S/4HANA development.
  • Prior consulting or client-facing delivery experience involving technical discussions and stakeholder management.
  • Experience leading small technical teams, development work streams, reviews, or delivery checkpoints.
  • Practical experience using Git for ABAP or comparable version-control practices alongside SAP transports.

Professional Tenure and Background

The expected career progression is from hands-on ABAP development into senior consultant responsibilities involving complex solution ownership, technical design, code quality, stakeholder collaboration, mentoring, and production accountability.

Suitable candidates should demonstrate sustained professional experience within established organizations that follow mature SAP delivery, change-control, testing, documentation, and support practices. Resumes should show measurable work accomplishments, such as independently delivered RICEF objects, successful integrations, performance improvements, production fixes, migration contributions, or leadership of defined technical work streams.

Frequent role changes without evidence of completed deliverables, or profiles dominated by coordination without hands-on development, would not represent the preferred background.


Compensation and Benefits

Compensation is experience-aligned and determined through a structured internal approach considering relevant tenure, current CTC, demonstrated skill depth, role complexity, interview performance, market demand, and internal salary parity. Offer decisions are reviewed through a standardized 25-parameter internal assessment without disclosing fixed salary bands in the hiring document.

Applicable benefits, leave, statutory coverage, and other employment provisions will be governed by prevailing organizational policy and communicated during the formal offer process.

Chemical / Process Engineer Scientific Software


Simreka | Scientific backend application features & modules


About the role


Simreka builds enterprise scientific software for chemicals, materials, and manufacturing (Virtual Experiments, formulation intelligence, process and sustainability workflows).

We are hiring a Chemical / Process Engineer with strong software and computational experience to work across the full stack of scientific product development:

1. Scientific backend models, solvers, data pipelines, validation

2. Application features and modules: product capabilities customers use in production

This is a domain-facing engineering role. You will combine process engineering, chemical engineering, data science, and computational engineering to turn physical science into reliable software, then into shipped product modules.


What you will do


Scientific backend

• Design and implement backend scientific engines: property models, process models, formulation logic, optimisation and simulation workflows

• Encode thermodynamics, transport, kinetics, unit operations, and materials behaviour into robust, tested software components

• Build computational pipelines (numerical methods, solvers, batch/async jobs, experiment orchestration)

• Develop data and feature pipelines for scientific and industrial datasets (lab, process, literature, customer data)

• Apply data science and statistical methods for validation, uncertainty, surrogate models, and model monitoring

• Define APIs and contracts so product modules can consume scientific services safely and reproducibly


Application features and modules

• Turn backend capabilities into product features and modules inside Simreka applications (e.g. Virtual Experiments, formulation tools, process/sustainability workflows)

• Work with product and design on user-facing scientific workflows: inputs, constraints, results, explainability, audit trails

• Integrate modules with platform services (auth, jobs, storage, deployment patterns for cloud / on-prem/hybrid)

• Improve performance, reliability, and maintainability of modules used in enterprise implementations

• Support customer-facing activities: workshops, solution design, validation discussions, and implementation feedback loops


Cross-cutting

• Collaborate with Scientific AI, Platform, Engineering, and Delivery

• Document assumptions, limits, and validation status for enterprise trust

• Contribute to reusable methods, accelerators, and internal standards

• Mentor others at the boundary of engineering science and software


Domain mix we expect


Chemical engineering: Reaction systems, separations, phase behaviour, property estimation


Process engineering: Flowsheets, unit operations, operating constraints, scale-up thinking


Computational engineering: Numerical methods, simulation, optimisation, high-quality scientific code


Data science: Data pipelines, statistical validation, surrogates, uncertainty, experiment design support


Product software: Backend services application modules, APIs, testing, delivery with customers


What we look for


Must-have

• Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or related field (MSc preferred; PhD welcome if hands-on)

• Experience building scientific or technical software backends (models, solvers, pipelines not only scripts)

• Experience delivering application features or modules on top of scientific/technical backends

• Strong Python (or equivalent) for scientific computing and service-style code

• Solid grounding in process / chemical engineering fundamentals used in real industrial problems

• Ability to work with data: cleaning, validation, metrics, and honest uncertainty

• Clear communication with both engineers and scientists; comfort in customer-facing technical discussions

• Evidence of ownership: shipped backend + product outcomes, not only analysis

IT Helpdesk Operations Analyst 2 5 Years
Role Overview

We are looking for an IT Helpdesk Operations Analyst to support our US-based client by managing IT support requests, user onboarding/offboarding, access management, and day-to-day IT operations. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a strong customer service mindset, and experience working with ticketing systems in a fast-paced environment.

This role will primarily focus on providing Level 1 and Level 2 IT support, maintaining Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environments, supporting end users, and coordinating incident resolution. Exposure to AWS cloud environments and DevOps practices is considered an advantage; however, the primary responsibility is to perform initial troubleshooting, gather relevant information, and escalate issues to the appropriate Development or Cloud Operations teams when required.

Key Responsibilities
  • Handle L1/L2 IT helpdesk tickets and ensure timely resolution within defined SLAs.
  • Provide technical support for hardware, software, operating systems, printers, and end-user devices.
  • Perform user onboarding and offboarding, including provisioning and deprovisioning user accounts, licenses, and access permissions.
  • Administer Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including user management, group management, password resets, and license administration.
  • Create, assign, prioritize, and update tickets using Jira or similar IT ticketing systems.
  • Monitor ticket queues and ensure timely communication with users throughout the resolution process.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting of application and infrastructure-related issues by collecting relevant logs, screenshots, error messages, and user impact details before escalating to Development or Cloud Operations teams.
  • Assist in incident coordination by tracking incidents, documenting updates, and following up with appropriate teams until resolution.
  • Maintain and update knowledge base articles, SOPs, and operational documentation.
  • Support software installations, system configurations, and workstation setup for new employees.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements to improve service quality and operational efficiency.
Required Skills
  • 2 5 years of experience in IT Helpdesk, IT Operations, Technical Support, or Service Desk roles.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) administration.
  • Experience with user onboarding, offboarding, access management, and license administration.
  • Experience using Jira, ServiceNow, or similar IT ticketing systems.
  • Good understanding of Windows and macOS operating systems and common end-user troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting remote users using Microsoft Teams, Remote Desktop, or similar remote support tools.
  • Understanding of incident management, SLA tracking, and escalation processes.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and customer service skills.

pool.title: Group Data Privacy- Data Privacy Analyst
pool.description:
Job Title- Group Data Privacy (GDP) - Data Privacy Analyst, AS

Location- Bangalore, India

Role Description

CAFC

  • CAFC is responsible for managing the compliance and anti-financial crime risk of Deutsche Bank Group. Our mission is to ensure that CAFC services are provided to the bank with the goals of protecting its integrity and reputation and managing legal risk to make transactions viable and safe. We partner with Risk, Regulation, Legal, Group Audit and others to provide a proactive integrated risk management approach.
  • We work closely with managers to coordinate activities across business lines so we avoid violations of laws. We make sure the Bank has up-to-date information on regulatory and legal changes and continues to be seen as a trusted, respected market participant.

Group Data Privacy (GDP)

  • Group Data Privacy (GDP) is an independent 2nd Line of Defense risk type control function within Legal which defines the risk management framework for data protection and privacy risks. GDP is located in Frankfurt, New York, London, and Berlin and Bangalore organized in a matrix structure with regional Data Protection Officers (DPOs) and Business Partners providing guidance to Business Divisions and Infrastructure Functions.
  • Moreover, GDP manages a global network of local, internal data protection officers and rolled-out a controls framework in order to safeguard Deutsche Bank s integrity and reputation and to ensure the correct processing of personal data entrusted to us. As part of the TPRM process, as a 2LoD control function, GDP is mandated to review third party outsourcing activities adherence with data privacy requirements.

What we ll offer you

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you ll enjoy

  • Best in class leave policy
  • Gender neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
  • Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and Term life Insurance
  • Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities

  • Advise and perform on the Data Protection Impact Assessment, in close collaboration with the stakeholders in the 1st Line and the respective GDP Business Partner and DPO. Ensure a professional documentation of the DPIA relevant facts, the (potential) privacy risk and mitigation measures.
  • Adivse and support in the banks global AI related governance process (AI Oversight Forum), in close collaboration with the stakeholders in the 1st Line, the other Risk Function in the AIOF as well the respective GDP Business Partner and DPO. Ensure a professional documentation of the AI use case, support the identification of (potential) privacy risk and mitigation measures in a timely manner .
  • Advise and perform the initial review of Data Breach notifications ensuring that the respective GDP Business Partner and DPO are timely involved and support them with their Data Breach assessment and documentation in order to avoid and mitigate potential data privacy risks
  • Advise and support the Service Officers of divisions and infrastructure functions on Data Protection related controls, attestations and evidences and GDP Assessment in order to meet the data protection requirements including Schrems II requirements.
  • Remain informed of regulatory developments in the data protection related outsourcing requirements including relevant GDP Policies and procedures as well as (assist if required in) maintenance of GDP Key Operating Documents
  • Prepare submission to GDP Business Partners respectively local DPO for risk acceptance / approval in line with GDP Key Operating Documents (KOD), follow up and escalation, if required.
  • Maintain GDP related documentation of transactions, respective findings and documented risks in the GDP tool.
  • Remain informed of regulatory developments in the data protection related outsourcing requirements including relevant GDP Policies and procedures as well as (assist if required in) maintenance of GDP Key Operating Documents
  • Collaborate closely with GDP Business Partner and local DPOs as well as other control functions units performing privacy assessment tasks.
  • Develop and maintain knowledge of the data privacy regulatory requirements applicable to DB incl. the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and remain up-to-date with relevant regulatory requirements and industry trends.
  • Maintain close collaboration with other functions within GDP such as Law Monitoring and Training Awareness.
  • Provide ad hoc support for Controls Assurance activities when required.

Your skills and experience

  • University degree, preferably in Business or Operations, law degree a plus
  • Knowledge of privacy regulations, financial industry, outsourcing or IT background a plus
  • Experience with managing deadlines and working to tight deadlines
  • Experience in making formal (written or oral) presentations and recommendations in a corporate setting
  • English proficiency (oral and written) a must. German a plus
  • Computer proficiency in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Lotus Notes required
  • Experience in SharePoint or other database tools a plus

Competencies

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to articulate issues in plain and clear language orally (as well as in writing) which enables the audience to follow easily
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Ability to handle stress and high volumes
  • Ability to reach solutions proactively, quickly and diplomatically
  • Strategic and proactive approach to problem identification, analysis and resolution
  • Ability to work independently, with minimal to no oversight
  • Ability to work in an intercultural environment

  • Experience in personnel management are an advantage

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs .

How we ll support you

  • Training and development to help you excel in your career
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

pool.title: DB2 Migration Specialist
pool.description:
Role & responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced Database Migration Consultant to lead and execute enterprise-scale DB2 migration engagements for our clients. The ideal candidate has deep, hands-on expertise migrating IBM DB2 databases (LUW and/or z/OS) to modern target platforms, and brings additional experience with Oracle and/or Teradata migrations as a strong plus. This is a client-facing, delivery-focused role suited to someone who can own technical migration strategy end-to-end from assessment through cutover and post-migration validation.


Preferred candidate profile


  • Lead assessment and discovery of legacy DB2 environments (schemas, stored procedures, triggers, jobs, ETL dependencies, data volumes) to scope migration effort and risk
  • Design and execute migration strategies for DB2 target platforms (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Teradata, or cloud-native databases), including schema conversion, data type mapping, and SQL/PL-SQL/SQL PL translation
  • Build and tune ETL/data pipelines for bulk data migration, incremental sync, and cutover, ensuring data integrity and minimal downtime
  • Convert and optimize stored procedures, triggers, views, and batch jobs from DB2 SQL PL (and where applicable, Oracle PL/SQL or Teradata BTEQ/SQL) to the target platform's dialect
  • Perform data validation and reconciliation between source and target systems (row counts, checksums, business-rule validation)
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks pre- and post-migration (indexing strategy, partitioning, query optimization)
  • Partner with client stakeholders, DBAs, and application teams to plan cutover windows, rollback strategies, and go-live support
  • Document migration methodology, technical decisions, and runbooks for client handoff
  • Where applicable, leverage Codehive's internal migration accelerator tooling to reduce manual conversion effort and improve delivery timelines
  • Mentor junior team members on DB2 migration best practices
